consequences: Event closure records an investigation decision; it does not fix the algorithm or pass release gates. Lists are bounded to 100 records with explicit truncation, cases paginate. Native installed acceptance and remaining F01-F30 work stay open.
context: F21 exposed only persisted snapshot counts, with no desktop case inspection, baseline comparison or event closure. F28 and F09 also need truthful failure and late-response handling.
decision: Expose owner-backed safe quality DTOs through a five-minute main-window native-held capability. Read cases and compare baselines without creating events. Resolve one event using explicit confirmation, revision-checked BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction and atomic audit, with idempotent repeats. Keep raw eval bodies and payloads private. Reject mismatched history identity and do not present unread model configuration as empty.
title: Scoped desktop quality inspection and audited resolution
